notes.title: Full release!
notes.notes:
[p]After 7 years of development I can now finally consider Powerlust to be a finished game![/p][p]The main goal was to finish the story mode, which is now done.[/p][p]Does that mean there will be no more updates?
No, of course not.[/p][p]I have a ton of other stuff I want to add.
My main focus will be adding more variety to the items and adding more endgame stuff.[/p][p]I think legendary items with unique abilities and being able to combine multiple of them into one through crafting is what makes the game fun, so I want to add even more OP combinations in the future :][/p]

notes.title: Click to move added!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey![/p][p][/p][p]I've added a new control scheme to the game![/p][p]You can now disable WSAD in the settings and use a more Diablo like control scheme.[/p][p]Other things in the update:
- Navigation fixes for minions.[/p][p]- Capitol fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]If you find any navigation issues please let me know![/p][p][/p][p]BR,[/p][p]Bart.[/p]

notes.title: Story mode finale!
notes.notes: [p]Version 1.68.07 released:[/p][p]- [b]Final part of the story mode!!![/b][/p][p]- Added a [b]wiki button[/b] in main menu.[/p][p]- Improved tree performance.[/p][p]- Added [b]manual import/export[/b] to the PC version.[/p][p]- A bunch of bugfixes.[/p]

Made teleport use movement stick first.

notes.title: Crafting/combining items added!
notes.notes:
Added crafting/combining items.
Added item essence and disenchanting.
Added more power levels (up to 25) and tweaked some stats there.
Added background to legendary and set items in the inventory and store.
Fixed - the X button on controller doesn't work in conversations that have "...".
When going to dungeon after eternal crypt you always get crypt monsters - fixed.
Fixed loot filter screen for controllers.
Fixed horde attack screen for controllers.
Fixed horde attack scrolls being taken from all players, now it's only the host that pays.
Added a cap for block stat (max 50% before block ability).
Fixed an issue where the dungeon randomization would be disabled after getting back through town portal.
Added formatting for damage numbers.

notes.title: A few new things and fixes ;]
notes.notes:
New stuff:
- [b]Dungeon mode characters can access the story mode now![/b]
- [b]New challenge - Eternal Crypt![/b]
- [b]Multiplayer fix for story mode![/b]
- Made the reward for boss horde mode better.
- Coil, blizzard and fire walk graphics bug when used with shadow fade fixed.
- Path of Righteousness fix for roof boss fight.
- Made the item glow dark grey after you walk over it if it's disabled in your loot filter.

notes.title: Releasing Powerlust now!
notes.notes:
It took quite a while, but I was finally able to get this game released on Steam.
I'd never expect I will have my own game available here, so I'm super happy it's happening!
I'm also super stressed about how the launch will go, but I guess that's inevitable.

I'd highly appreciate [b]you buying the game[/b]!
Every sale increases the chance of me being able to do gamedev full time, which would be incredible!

notes.title: 🔥Playing the FULL game with commentary!
notes.notes:
Check out how Powerlust plays with my commentary on top!
Powerlust is an old school action RPG inspired by games like Diablo 1, Might and Magic 7 and Baldur's Gate. Made by a guy who loved playing them.

​Travel through an open world, design your own character class and feed your LUST for POWER by crushing your foes. Bonus replayability thanks to procedural generation and tons of abilities. Legendary items with unique abilities and item sets will allow you to completely change the gameplay of your favorite class. Optional permadeath for hardcore roguelike fans!

What's inside?​

[list]
[*] Procedurally generated dungeons.       
[*] Skill-based combat.       
[*] No rigid classes.       
[*] Tons of masteries, skills and builds.       
[*] Open world to explore.       
[*] Optional permadeath.       
[*] Controller support.     
[*] Awesome discord community.       
[/list]
